name: Survey tile in Pisces
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 2.5 degrees south of the ecliptic in Pisces, imaged by SPHEREx 23 times in 7 visits over 70 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 40 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.9 days starting 2026-01-05, at wavelengths from 0.79 to 4.49 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
